title: Files uploaded in the admin (media library, logo, product images) are written to apps/admin/public/uploads but served from the storefront origin -> 404 on the storefront
steps: Admin /t/demo-shop/media -> upload a PNG -> open the image URL on http://demo-shop.localhost:3000/uploads/tenants/<id>/media/<file>.png
expected: Uploaded file is reachable on the storefront (comment in storage.ts says dev files land in apps/web/public/uploads)
actual: GET .../uploads/tenants/01a14029-.../media/1792156830580-d05cdkzm.png -> HTTP 404; the file is in apps/admin/public/uploads (5 files there) because the admin process cwd is apps/admin. LOCAL_UPLOAD_DIR is not set in .env.
evidence: tooling/qa/admin-journey.ts step 7 FAIL (log tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_core-journey.log), screenshot tooling/screenshots/qa-admin-fail-7.png; find apps/admin/public/uploads -type f -> 5 files, apps/web/public/uploads -> 38 files
suggestedFix: Resolve the local root from the monorepo (e.g. path.resolve(repoRoot,'apps/web/public/uploads')) or set LOCAL_UPLOAD_DIR in .env.example for both apps; make publicUrl absolute or let apps/web serve the shared dir.

title: New tenants inherit the template's sample PromptPay ID, bank account and contact details: customers of a brand-new shop pay to 0812345678 / 'Siam Atelier จำกัด 123-4-56789-0' and the checklist marks payments + LINE as done
steps: Sign up a new user -> /onboarding -> pick 'ร้านค้าออนไลน์' -> name 'ร้านผ้าทอบ้านนา' -> create. Inspect tenants.settings, the dashboard checklist and http://<slug>.localhost:3000/
expected: A new tenant starts with no payment receiver (payments disabled or a blocking 'set up payments' step) and empty/own contact data; checklist items 'ตั้งค่าช่องทางรับเงิน' and 'เชื่อม LINE' are not done
actual: tenants.settings of ac-shop-vcre: payments={promptpayId:'0812345678', promptpayName:'Siam Atelier', bankAccounts:[{bank:'กสิกรไทย',name:'Siam Atelier จำกัด',number:'123-4-56789-0'}], enabled:{promptpay,bankTransfer,cod}}, contact={phone:'081-234-5678', lineId:'@siamatelier', email:'hello@siam-atelier.co', address:'99/9 ถ.นิมมานเหมินท์ ...'}. Same for cafe (0812345678), salon/clinic (0891112222), restaurant (0829876543), corporate contact. Storefront home and /contact render 081-234-5678, @siamatelier, hello@siam-atelier.co; floating LINE links to https://line.me/R/ti/p/%40northstar for the corporate tenant. Dashboard checklist shows 'ตั้งค่าช่องทางรับเงิน' and 'เชื่อม LINE' ticked (33%) on a tenant that is 1 minute old. Payment QR uses resolvePromptpayId(settings) (packages/core/src/payments/index.ts:160) so real orders would be paid to the sample PromptPay number.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_core-onboard.log ('## tenant shop' ... lines), screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-admin_core-dash-shop.png, tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_core-peek1.ts output: 'ac-shop-vcre.localhost:3000 /contact 200 081-234-5678:true siamatelier:true hello@siam-atelier.co:true'
suggestedFix: In provisionTenant strip settings.payments (promptpayId, promptpayName, bankAccounts) and settings.contact from template settings for real signups (keep them only for demo-* seeding), or disable payment methods until the owner sets their own receiver; base checklist 'done' on owner-entered values (e.g. onboarding.steps) only.

title: Corporate template: a new tenant's contact form e-mails every submission to the template address contact@northstar.co.th (customer PII leaks to a third party)
where: packages/templates/src/corporate.ts:161 (forms insert notifyEmails: ['contact@northstar.co.th']) via provisionTenant seed
steps: Create a tenant from 'เว็บบริษัท / เอเจนซี่' in /onboarding, then query forms for that tenant
expected: Form notifications go to the new owner's e-mail (or nowhere until set)
actual: forms row for ac-northwind-co-vcre: {slug:'contact', notifyEmails:['contact@northstar.co.th']}; storefront /contact shows the form, so visitors' name/phone/message would be mailed to northstar.co.th
suggestedFix: Seed notifyEmails with the owner's e-mail (pass ownerUserId/email into seed) or leave it empty for non-demo tenants.

title: Slug inputs drop a trailing hyphen on every keystroke, so 'my-shop' typed on the keyboard becomes 'myshop' (onboarding wizard and new-page dialog)
where: apps/admin/src/app/onboarding/wizard.tsx:58-66 clientSlug (.replace(/^-|-$/g,'')) used in onChange at :270; same pattern in apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/pages/new-page-dialog.tsx:19-25 auto()
steps: Onboarding step 2 -> click the slug field -> type m,y,-,s,h,o,p
expected: Field shows my-shop (hint says 'ใช้ a-z 0-9 และขีดกลาง')
actual: Field shows 'myshop' – the '-' is stripped immediately because the sanitizer trims trailing hyphens while typing; a hyphenated subdomain/page slug can only be produced by pasting or via the name field
suggestedFix: Only trim leading/trailing hyphens on blur/submit (server already normalises), not in onChange.

title: Onboarding slug availability shows stale results (reserved 'www' shown as available with 'ถัดไป' enabled) because in-flight checks are not cancelled
where: apps/admin/src/app/onboarding/wizard.tsx:85-103 (setTimeout + await checkSlugAction; cleanup only clears the timer, response is applied to whatever slug is current)
steps: Onboarding step 2 -> change the slug quickly: 'admin' -> 'www' (each ~1.8 s apart)
expected: 'www' shows 'ชื่อนี้ถูกสงวนไว้' (it is in RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS) and Next stays disabled
actual: 'www' showed 'ว่าง! ใช้ชื่อนี้ได้' with ถัดไป enabled; 'xn-abc' showed 'ชื่อนี้ถูกใช้แล้ว' (that was the answer for the previous value 'qa-test-22bt'). Server actions are queued, so each late answer is applied to the newer value. createSiteAction re-checks, so the user only fails at the final step.
evidence: admin_core-onboard.log lines "## slug 'www': {...\"status\":\"ว่าง! ใช้ชื่อนี้ได้\",\"nextEnabled\":true}" and "## slug 'xn--abc': {\"slug\":\"xn-abc\",\"status\":\"ชื่อนี้ถูกใช้แล้ว\"}"; packages/core/src/env.ts:43 has 'www' reserved
suggestedFix: Ignore responses whose r.slug !== current slug (or use a cancelled flag/AbortController in the effect cleanup).

title: Restaurant tenants get no sales/order KPIs on the dashboard and are told to 'enable the shop, booking or top-up module'; the 'add a real item' checklist step can never complete
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/dashboard/queries.ts:45-97 (only commerce/booking/topup branches; no restaurant branch) and :52 of dashboard/page.tsx (fallback card); checklist 'content' href falls back to /pages
steps: Create a tenant from 'ร้านอาหาร + QR สั่งที่โต๊ะ' (or open /t/demo-restaurant/dashboard) and look at the KPI row
expected: Today's restaurant orders / paid revenue / open tables (restaurant module is enabled) and a checklist step pointing to the menu
actual: KPI row: 'ลูกค้าใหม่ 7 วัน 0 | ยอดขายวันนี้ — เปิดโมดูลร้านค้า จองคิว หรือเติมเกมเพื่อดูยอด' for tenant ac-rest-vcre (modules cms,restaurant). 'เพิ่มรายการจริงอย่างน้อย 1 รายการ' links to /pages and realItem is never set for restaurant menu items.
suggestedFix: Add a restaurant branch (restaurant orders today, paid sum, open table sessions; realItem from menu items created after provisioning) and point the checklist to /restaurant/menu.
